name: Nocturne Reaper

master_prompt: A cursed cathedral city where death itself walks the streets at midnight, collecting debts owed by the living in exchange for forbidden power
master_prompt_enhanced: In the crumbling spires of the cathedral city, midnight summons Death, a cloaked figure who roams the cobblestone streets in search of the living’s unpaid debts, offering forbidden power in exchange.
